scope: Executable target suite, not parser-only evidence. A backend may report UNSUPPORTED with structured diagnostic until it implements this profile, but must not report execution parity.

requirements.run: Compile actual source with exact-head backend and execute isolated guest. Assert main exit_code, no imported host privileges and deterministic artifact bytes.
requirements.reject: Reject exact source in compiler admission/type check without creating executable artifact, with stable diagnostic family.
requirements.unavailable: Report UNSUPPORTED, never a PASS or an opaque fallback; no host-side JavaScript interpretation may substitute for guest execution.
requirements.provenance: Record backend commit SHA, source fixture Git blob SHA, compiler artifact SHA-256, actual executed job steps, stdout/stderr, exit status and runtime environment.

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = |_| : int -> 5; return v(41); }
cases.meaning: one ignored parameter inferred from an actual checked direct call

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = |_| : int -> 5; return v(true); }
cases.meaning: ignored parameter still has a checked argument type

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = || : int -> 5; return v(); }
cases.meaning: zero arguments, not an arity-polymorphic placeholder

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = |int x| : int -> x + 1; return v(41); }
cases.meaning: type-first annotation and checked scalar direct call

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = |x: int| : int -> x + 1; return v(41); }

const fnc v = |int _| : int -> 5;
pub fnc main(): int { return v(41); }
cases.meaning: module ABI fixed by explicit parameter type

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = _ : int -> 5; return v(41); }
cases.meaning: bare underscore must never be interpreted as lambda

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = x : int -> x + 1; return v(41); }
cases.meaning: bare named parameter head must never be accepted

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = || : int -> 5; return v(41); }
cases.meaning: a zero-parameter lambda rejects one argument

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { const fnc v = |_| : int -> 5; return v(); }
cases.meaning: ignored argument still counts toward arity

cases.source:
const fnc v = |_| : int -> 5;
pub fnc main(): int { return v(41); }
cases.meaning: parses with pipes but module-scope parameter needs an explicit ABI type

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { val runtime = 41; const fnc v = |_| : int -> runtime; return v(41); }
cases.meaning: const direct callable must not capture runtime variables

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { val v = fnc(int x) -> x + 1; return 0; }
cases.meaning: anonymous fnc(...) function expression must have explicit |...| delimiters; named fnc declarations remain distinct

cases.source: pub fnc main(): int { val v = (int x) -> x + 1; return 0; }
cases.meaning: legacy parenthesized lambda parameter head is not canonical Atto syntax and must be version-gated
